terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A standing charcoal brazier on legs, not a cart: nothing rolls, opens, turns or swings, nothing attaches -- the bag hangs from a fixed hook -- so one root pivot and zero sockets. Morning street corners and school gates; the pork skewers and the sticky-rice bag are the read. Sooty black steel, rust on the angle iron, grey ash with glowing embers, charred bamboo.

reasoning: ONE steel merge -- the half-drum as an extruded ring profile (r 0.155, 5 mm wall, 20-segment arc) with a solid plate of the same profile at each end, folded lips along both long edges and both ends, a rear rod the skewers rest on, an ash slab with 22 charcoal / ash / ember chunks and two ember strips, the drawer housing with its proud front and handle, four splayed L-angle legs (two 6 mm flanges each), the crook as a swept round bar and the rice mass as an ellipsoid; ONE translucent bag lathe; ONE InstancedMesh of twenty skewers: THREE draw calls of 4.

Three materials as the registry notes require: sooty steel (vertex colours: soot-black drum, rusty legs, ash, charcoal, ember, rice), the skewer row (bamboo, scorched stick, three meat tones and char as vertex colours on a WHITE material), and the translucent bag at opacity 0.68.
One repetition system: twenty skewers off one nine-box geometry (handle, scorched stick, four flattened meat pieces, three char scraps), jittered in x, y, z, pitch, yaw and roll by index.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the row of skewers across an open half-drum on tall splayed legs with the bag on its crook; the skewer row is instanced because it is the whole silhouette and the budget cannot spend twenty draw calls on it.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.90 x 0.85 x 0.44 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A 0.68 m half-drum trough r 0.155 with its rim at 0.60 m on four splayed L-angle legs to feet at +-0.40, +-0.185; a drawer housing 0.26 x 0.10 x 0.20 under the +X half; a round-bar crook off the -X end plate curling to 0.85 m with a squat bag hanging 0.295-0.70 m; twenty long skewers across the rim, meat on the front half, bamboo overhanging the rear rod.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: Third build (2026-09-01), authored from the PLATE: the Meshy proxy fused three legs into one, mirrored the hook to +X and read w:h:d 1:0.550:0.379, so it fixes nothing here beyond the stations. Plate mask (scratch/_prop/_plate_moo.mjs, backdrop 163): foreground w/h 1.220 in the three-quarter view; drum ~0.31 across; skewer handles overhang the rear rim by ~0.10; hook and bag on the LEFT. Built: x -0.514 (bag) to +0.420 (rear rod), 0.934 against the declared 0.90 (+3.8%); y 0 to 0.857 at the crook (declared 0.85); z -0.254 (skewer handles) to +0.205 (feet at +-0.185), 0.459 against the declared 0.44, which was corrected from 0.35 on this build with the arithmetic in the asset notes. Stations: drum equator 0.57, rim 0.60 (3 cm of vertical wall above the equator, lips folded out), drum bottom 0.415, drawer 0.345-0.445 under the +X half, legs from the belly at y 0.52 to feet at +-0.40 x, crook top 0.848, bag 0.295-0.70.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: w:h:d 1:0.550:0.379, 3,803 triangles, three legs fused into one and the hook arm mirrored to +X (scratch/_mon/vox.mjs SIDE/END/TOP maps). The plate puts the hook and bag on the LEFT and the plate is the authority; the proxy contributed only the vertical stations.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components and one repetition system: 3 of 4.

materials.note: steel, skewer and bag: 3 of 3, as the registry notes require.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 3,920 of 4,000: a 44-point ring extrusion with two 23-point end plates, ~40 boxes, a 20-point 20-segment lathe, a 12-point swept crook, a 16x12 ellipsoid and a nine-box skewer instanced twenty times.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: An extruded ring profile with solid end plates for the drum; rotated box pairs for the L-angle legs; a swept round bar for the crook; a lathe for the bag; an ellipsoid for the rice; boxes for everything else.
One InstancedMesh: twenty skewers with per-index offset, pitch, yaw and roll.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.

risks.description: The plate's steel is luma 40, below the backdrop; a mid-dark render of the drum would be read as a hole.
risks.mitigation: Carried at the plate luma in the LOWER neutral band (renders ~22 on flanks); the open legs already make this an --allow-holes prop, with _holecc thicknesses recorded per azimuth.
